invariants.rationale: It is standard practice for method parameters to be non-null for typical use in the body. Also, the method does not perform null checks before invoking methods on inputRecords.
The size of a List is always non-negative. If it is empty, its size is 0 or more. This expresses a basic but meaningful property of List.
The body of the method accesses methods on each element of inputRecords, suggesting elements are expected to be non-null.
The method uses rec.getPartitionPath() for each record, implying partition paths are expected to be non-null.
getCurrentLocation() is called on each record and can return null, which is handled by Option.ofNullable in the method body; this expresses that the call is always valid regardless of its result.
